title: cell derivs
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkCellDerivatives for all linear cell types with hedgehog glyphs showing the computed gradient at cell centers.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCellCenters](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellCenters.html) — cell centers.
- [vtkCellDerivatives](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellDerivatives.html) — cell derivatives.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkFloatArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFloatArray.html) — stores an array of floating-point values.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkHedgeHog](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHedgeHog.html) — hedge hog.
- [vtkHexagonalPrism](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHexagonalPrism.html) — hexagonal prism.
- [vtkHexahedron](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHexahedron.html) — hexahedron.
- [vtkLine](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLine.html) — line.
- [vtkPentagonalPrism](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPentagonalPrism.html) — pentagonal prism.
- [vtkPixel](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPixel.html) — pixel.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkPolyLine](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyLine.html) — poly line.
- [vtkPolyVertex](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyVertex.html) — poly vertex.
- [vtkPolygon](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolygon.html) — polygon.
- [vtkPyramid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPyramid.html) — pyramid.
- [vtkQuad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuad.html) — quad.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkTetra](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTetra.html) — tetra.
- [vtkTriangle](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTriangle.html) — triangle.
- [vtkTriangleStrip](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTriangleStrip.html) — triangle strip.
- [vtkUnstructuredGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGrid.html) — unstructured grid.
- [vtkVertex](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVertex.html) — vertex.
- [vtkVoxel](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVoxel.html) — voxel.
- [vtkWedge](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWedge.html) — wedge.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
